text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Fest is here, and the
popular
model Голд Сити is expected to
be inundated by
her fans.

We've gathered your fans in the gym. I'm
leaving
the rest to the host. Go check on
her.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Brian.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: If you wanna say something, say it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I don't know, it's just funny to see you
working
hard like this.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
You're usually on the rooftop just killing
time.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Busy day. I need to get going.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Are you guys not on good terms?

text_block_list.text: Not good, but not bad either.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, when I need to go
somewhere and be
alone, I run into her
slacking off.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Forget about that now, though. I've got
fans
waiting, so let's go.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Aaahhh! Cityyyy!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming, everyone. So...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Quiet, everyooone! You there, stay in
line!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
So you're the host, Bamboo. Can you
handle this?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, who do you think I have to deal
with on the
daily?
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
If I can handle you, you big
troublemaker, I can
handle—
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
Omigod, what a photo op! Bamboo,
City! Look
this way!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text: Do an UmaTok! Do a Q and A!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text:
W-wait, me too?! No, I'm just the host,
so...
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
Come on, why not? It isn't like you to
shy away.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I'm not shying away! It's just that today is

supposed to be your day...
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
But oh well... I guess I can't argue with
the star of
the show! I present to
everyone, the City and
Bamboo talk
special!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: You're so easy...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Okay, we're taking questions from the
audience!
Raise your hand if you've got
one!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
I've got one! You two share a room,
right? Is
there anything about each other
that only the two
of you know?
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: Um.
text_block_list.name: City and Bamboo

text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap, clap!
Something only I know? Hmm...
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: Please don't say anything weird, okay?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Anything weird? Like how you
sometimes call me
"daddy" when you're
half asleep?
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: Ooohh!
text_block_list.name: City's Fan

text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! I don't do that!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Yes, you do. You never called me
"Mommy," but
one time you did call me
"Bunny."
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: "Bunny"? ...Ohhh!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
That's the name of a doll I wanted when
I was a
child! I was too stubborn to admit
it though...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And that's why you still dream about it?
Wow,
how cute.
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: AAAAAHHHHH!
text_block_list.name: City's Fan

text_block_list.text: Ack! What are you screaming for?!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
Oh! This one is actually good
information—it's
about City's routine!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, what are you—
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
She really keeps all the letters and gifts
she
receives from you fans, you know.
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
Sometimes she comes to our room ready
to drop
dead 'cause she's so tired, and
then she falls
asleep with all your letters
in her arms!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: AAAAAHHHHH!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text: B-Bamboo!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
What, was I not supposed to share that?
It's a
super heartwarming story!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
See, people tend to think you're all cool
and
distant, but this is your chance to
change that
impression!
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text:
But that's not the impression I want to
give!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
City reads all our letters... That's so
sweet!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
I know, I'm so happy! City's got such a
big heart!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: Well, they look pretty happy about it...
text_block_list.name: Бамбу Мемори

text_block_list.text: ...Ugh. End me, please.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: This is your doing.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
After the Q and A, the meet and greet
continues
with one-on-one
conversations.

Um, when I saw you run, I became an
even bigger
fan!
text_block_list.name: Fan C

text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Why did you quit the Triple Tiara? It
seemed like
the perfect fit for you!
text_block_list.name: Fan C

text_block_list.text: Well... that's because...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: After the event...

Hey, um... could I have some alone time?
There's
something I want to think
through.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Mm.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: The reason why I quit the Tiara tour...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
